mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy support, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a demand shock that reduces consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods, a FEDFUNDS rise does not produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not correlate with positive 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE does not produce negative 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.0%), a slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an impending economic peak, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In GDPC1 growth > 2.0% periods, a slowdown in GDP growth does not produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
